verdict.rationale: The evidence shows webhooks, REST/GraphQL APIs, a Checkout SDK and a vague mention of extending checkout. Webhooks send events to externally hosted code, and the Checkout SDK is a client-side library. Nothing documents serverless functions or hooks that run custom discount, shipping or validation logic inside the platform, so this is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject custom backend logic — discounts, shipping rules, validation — as serverless functions or hooks that run inside the platform
